About me

I am an industrial designer who specialized in UX/UI.

For more than four years I designed, built and coordinated physical product projects end to end: understanding what each client needs, prototyping before manufacturing, validating with the people who use the product, and iterating. It is the same process I now apply to digital products.

My professional experience is in physical products, not digital ones. My digital projects are portfolio projects and I say so in each case.

I am looking to join a digital product team where I can bring that end-to-end perspective.
